tools.name: qr_generate
tools.description: Generate a QR code as an SVG image from text or a URL. The code encodes the value directly — no tracking redirect, so it works forever. Interactive version: https://zaleso.com/qr

tools.name: password_generate
tools.description: Generate a cryptographically secure random password (crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling — no modulo bias). Returns the password and its entropy. Interactive version: https://zaleso.com/password

tools.name: ng_paye_calculate
tools.description: Calculate Nigeria PAYE income tax and net (take-home) salary under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025, effective for the 2026 tax year. Returns monthly take-home, monthly PAYE, the effective rate, and the full band-by-band working, with the statutory source and verification date. Handles pension (8%), NHF (2.

tools.name: json_format
tools.description: Format (pretty-print) or minify JSON. Invalid input returns the line and column of the error. Interactive version: https://zaleso.com/json

tools.name: ng_gross_for_take_home
tools.description: Work backwards from a target take-home to the gross salary that produces it, under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (2026 tax year). This is the question employers and contractors actually ask — "what must I pay for them to clear ₦500,000 a month" — and it cannot be answered by applying a rate, because PAYE

tools.name: ng_vat_calculate
tools.description: Add Nigerian VAT to a net amount, or extract the VAT already contained in a VAT-inclusive amount. Uses the verified statutory rate from the data layer and returns it with its source and effective date — never an assumed rate. Informational only — verify with the tax authority. Interactive version: h

tools.name: invoice_totals
tools.description: Compute invoice totals from line items: per-line totals, subtotal, an optional discount, optional tax (the verified Nigeria VAT preset or any rate you name), a deposit already paid, and the balance due. Country-agnostic. The interactive version also produces the PDF: https://zaleso.com/invoice

tools.name: amount_in_words
tools.description: Spell a monetary amount in words, the way a cheque or an invoice requires — "Four Thousand and Fifty Naira and Seventy-Five Kobo Only". Supports NGN, USD, EUR and GBP with the correct major and minor unit names. It is the row that goes above the signature line on the invoices at https://zaleso.com/i

tools.name: base64_convert
tools.description: Encode text to Base64, or decode Base64 back to text. UTF-8 throughout, so accented text, emoji, Arabic, Devanagari and CJK survive the round trip — the naive btoa/atob version does not. Interactive version: https://zaleso.com/base64

tools.name: usd_ngn_convert
tools.description: Convert between US dollars and Nigerian naira at the Central Bank of Nigeria's official NFEM rate — the volume-weighted average CBN publishes, not a parallel-market figure. Returns the converted amount with the rate, the trading date it applies to, and the CBN source. Interactive version: https://za

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "password_generate" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
